fonts.display: 'Roobert', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Roobert', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Sovereign Ink
palette.role: Primary text, headlines, nav, core UI — near-black with a barely-perceptible blue cast that separates it from pure black and lets violet accents feel native

palette.name: Signal White
palette.role: Card surfaces, elevated panels, button text on dark fills

palette.name: Mist Surface
palette.role: Page canvas, soft card backgrounds, subtle wash sections

palette.name: Cool Hairline
palette.role: Borders, dividers, input outlines, structural separators — the single neutral that holds the whole UI together

palette.name: Shadow Lichen
palette.role: Card inset shadow tint, quiet elevation layer

palette.name: Carbon Gray
palette.role: Secondary text, supporting copy, muted labels

palette.name: Ash Gray
palette.role: Button shadow tint, disabled affordances, tertiary text

palette.name: Violet Wash
palette.role: Tinted backgrounds for AI-adjacent surfaces, soft highlight washes, capability tags

palette.name: Cyber Cyan
palette.role: Blue wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Crimson Glow
palette.role: Red supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

palette.name: Info Blue
palette.role: Informational badges, neutral data callouts, non-critical status indicators
